subject: Registrant opt-in UI flow & recording retention plan for April webinar
messages:
From: Sofia Marquez <sofia@brightwave.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reconcile registration fields + recording retention (April 21 event)

Hi Evelyn —

Quick question as we finalize the BrightWave integration for your April 21 webinar: can you confirm the exact registrant fields you want on the public form vs. the confirmation email? The Ops team needs a definitive mapping so our registration export lines up with ON24/Zoom metadata.

Also: what’s Redwood’s preferred storage window for recordings? Our standard is 90 days on ON24, then an export to S3 if you want longer — but we can accommodate a shorter window if legal wants it.

High-level asks:
- Public form: first name, last name, work email, company, country.
- Hidden fields: account id, campaign_id (optional).
- Confirmation: opt-in checkbox for recording distribution + download link policy text.

Attaching a sample CSV of the fields we export. Can you and Ops confirm by EOD Monday?

Thanks,
Sofia Marquez
Senior Event Producer | BrightWave Events
Attachments: registrant_field_sample.csv (CSV)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Marquez <sofia@brightwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Reconcile registration fields + recording retention (April 21 event)

Hi Sofia — thanks for the CSV; that helps. Quick answers and requests below.

Public form (visible to registrants):
- First name (required)
- Last name (required)
- Work email (required)
- Company (optional)
- Country (optional)

Confirmation page + email (post-register):
- Include an explicit checkbox labeled: "I consent to be recorded and receive the webinar recording for 90 days" (unchecked by default).
- Confirmation email must include: short privacy blurb, link to retention policy, and an unsubscribe link.

Hidden/internal fields to pass in payload: account_id, campaign_id, lead_source. Please map them to columns: account_id -> acctId, campaign_id -> cmpId, lead_source -> leadSrc.

Recording retention: Redwood is OK with 90 days on ON24 for hosted viewing. Post-90-days we want the master exported to our S3 bucket (redwood-records-prod) for 1 year archival, then deleted. Can we get a confirmed export schedule?

Ben and Tessa — can you confirm ON24/Zoom export paths & a test slot tomorrow? I attached a short test plan with suggested checks.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: 2027-04-11_on24_zoom_test_plan.pdf (PDF)
From: Sofia Marquez <sofia@brightwave.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 13:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reconcile registration fields + recording retention (April 21 event)

Thanks for the quick reply, Evelyn.

We can implement the checkbox on the confirmation flow and will surface the exact column mapping in the export. A couple of small asks from compliance:
- Please confirm that the checkbox text you proposed will be used verbatim.
- If you have a short URL for the retention policy, we’ll include it in the confirmation email; otherwise we’ll link to the page you provide later.

Regarding export: we can schedule daily exports from ON24 to your S3 bucket starting day-of-event + 30 days to allow for quick turnaround edits, or do a one-off full export after 90 days. Which do you prefer? Daily exports are slightly more ops heavy but provide quicker access.

Also: if you want downloadable masters accessible from the confirmation email, we need to flag that as a product ask — we typically only link the hosted player.

Let me know and we’ll push the config.

Best,
Sofia

Subject: RE: Reconcile registration fields + recording retention (April 21 event)

Quick tech notes / proposals:

- Zoom: cloud recording of the panel will be available immediately after the session in the Zoom cloud. We can enable auto-download to an S3 bucket via our infra job. That job can run nightly and pick up any new recordings — I recommend nightly export for Day-of then daily for +30 days, after that a scheduled full pull at day 90.

- ON24: ON24 will host the player (hosted playback) and allows export of the MP4 masters on request. BrightWave can trigger an export the week after the event and we can pick that up with the same S3 job.

- Master file naming convention we propose: redwood_event_<eventdate>_<org>_<env>.mp4 (e.g., redwood_event_20270421_redwood_prod.mp4) — helps automated retention policies.

Test slots: I can do an integration run tomorrow 10:30–11:00 PT. Checks in the test plan include:
  * registration form submission test (public + hidden fields)
  * confirmation email verification (checkbox behavior + link)
  * simulated panel recording (short 2–3 min run) -> ensure Zoom cloud capture + ON24 ingestion
  * S3 export verification (file present, correct naming, checksum)

Attaching the test plan that Evelyn included with some inline notes.

Ben Carter
Senior Systems Engineer, Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference
